description: This file provides functions to parse and extract dependency information from Bazel WORKSPACE files, specifically handling http_archive rules and their metadata.

methods.name: HTTPArchiveRule
methods.description: Returns a CallExpr describing the provided http_archive rule, or nil if the expr is not an http_archive rule.

methods.name: parseString
methods.description: Parses a build.Expr to extract a string value.

methods.name: parseSingleElementList
methods.description: Parses a build.Expr expected to be a single-element list and returns its string content.

methods.name: ParseHTTPArchiveRule
methods.description: Parses a single http_archive rule CallExpr to extract dependency metadata into an Entry.

methods.name: ParseHTTPArchiveRules
methods.description: Parses the entire WORKSPACE.bazel source to extract all http_archive rules as a list of Entry objects.
